tasks.label: Build FCU
tasks.detail: Build the FCU board (configure first with 'Configure FCU' if build/fcu-Debug is missing).

tasks.label: Build ECU
tasks.detail: Build the ECU board (configure first with 'Configure ECU' if build/ecu-Debug is missing).

tasks.label: Configure FCU
tasks.detail: One-time / after-CMake-change configure of the FCU board.

tasks.label: Configure ECU
tasks.detail: One-time / after-CMake-change configure of the ECU board.

tasks.label: Configure FCU Release (-O1)
tasks.detail: One-time / after-CMake-change configure of the FCU board at -O1 Release (CMAKE_*_FLAGS_RELEASE = '-O1 -g0' in gcc-arm-none-eabi.cmake, no -flto).

tasks.label: Configure ECU Release (-O1)
tasks.detail: One-time / after-CMake-change configure of the ECU board at -O1 Release (CMAKE_*_FLAGS_RELEASE = '-O1 -g0' in gcc-arm-none-eabi.cmake, no -flto).

tasks.label: Build FCU Release (-O1)
tasks.detail: Build the FCU at -O1 Release (configure first with 'Configure FCU Release (-O1)' if build/fcu-Release is missing).

tasks.label: Build ECU Release (-O1)
tasks.detail: Build the ECU at -O1 Release (configure first with 'Configure ECU Release (-O1)' if build/ecu-Release is missing).

tasks.label: Flash ECU
tasks.detail: Flash the -O1 Release ecu_CM7.elf to the ECU over ST-Link (connect-under-reset), then reset and run. The ExternalProject writes the Release ELF to src/boards/ecu/CM7/build-Release/ (Debug builds go to build-Debug/).

tasks.label: Flash FCU
tasks.detail: Flash the -O1 Release fcu_CM7.elf to the FCU over ST-Link (connect-under-reset), then reset and run. The ExternalProject writes the Release ELF to src/boards/fcu/CM7/build-Release/ (Debug builds go to build-Debug/).
